variables.name: DJANGO_ENV
variables.description: Environment: production (or staging). Turns on HTTPS redirect, secure cookies, HSTS and TLS to PostgreSQL.

variables.name: DJANGO_DEBUG
variables.description: Must stay off in Azure.

variables.name: DJANGO_SECRET_KEY
variables.description: Random value of at least 50 characters. Changing it signs everyone out.

variables.name: ALLOWED_HOSTS
variables.description: Comma-separated public host names. The Azure default host (*.azurecontainerapps.io or *.azurewebsites.net) is added automatically.

variables.name: CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS
variables.description: Comma-separated https:// origins matching ALLOWED_HOSTS.

variables.name: ADMIN_URL_PATH
variables.description: Path of the administration site; change it to make the admin harder to find.

variables.name: TIME_ZONE
variables.description: Time zone for dates shown in the application.

variables.name: LEGACY_TABLES_MANAGED
variables.description: Must stay off: Django never creates or alters the existing v2 tables.

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.description: postgres://<user>:<password>@<server>.postgres.database.azure.com:5432/<database>?sslmode=require

variables.name: DB_SSLMODE
variables.description: TLS mode for PostgreSQL when DATABASE_URL does not set sslmode.

variables.name: DB_CONN_MAX_AGE
variables.description: Seconds a database connection is reused.

variables.name: ACTIVITYINFO_BASE_URL
variables.description: ActivityInfo API root.

variables.name: ACTIVITYINFO_TOKEN
variables.description: ActivityInfo service-account API token.

variables.name: ETOOLS_BASE_URL
variables.description: eTools API root.

variables.name: ETOOLS_TOKEN
variables.description: eTools service-account token.

variables.name: SYNC_STALENESS_HOURS
variables.description: A source is reported stale after this many hours without a successful sync.

variables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
variables.description: OpenAI API key (a project key from platform.openai.com) for the AI assistant (Ask NeuroDB). Leave unset to switch the assistant off.

variables.name: AI_ASSISTANT_MODEL
variables.description: OpenAI model (ChatGPT, via the OpenAI Responses API) that answers questions.

variables.name: AI_ASSISTANT_EFFORT
variables.description: none | minimal | low | medium | high | xhigh | max: reasoning effort, depth of reasoning vs cost and speed. Supported values vary by model (gpt-5.5: none, low, medium, high, xhigh). Any other value stops the app at start-up.

variables.name: AI_ASSISTANT_HOURLY_LIMIT
variables.description: Questions per user per hour.

variables.name: ENTRA_TENANT_ID
variables.description: Microsoft Entra tenant id. Leave the three ENTRA_* variables out to use password sign-in only.

variables.name: ENTRA_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Client id of the NeuroDB app registration; redirect URI https://<host>/accounts/microsoft/login/callback/.

variables.name: ENTRA_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: Client secret of the app registration.

variables.name: AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT
variables.description: Blob storage account for uploaded files and import copies. Access uses the managed identity, no key.

variables.name: AZURE_CONTAINER_MEDIA
variables.description: Blob container name.

variables.name: AZURE_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Client id of the user-assigned managed identity (roles: Storage Blob Data Contributor, Key Vault Secrets User, AcrPull).

variables.name: APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING
variables.description: Enables Application Insights tracing; leave out to disable.

variables.name: LOG_FORMAT
variables.description: json for Log Analytics, plain for local reading.

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Application log level.

variables.name: RUN_MIGRATIONS
variables.description: Apply pending database migrations (under a lock) every time the website container starts. false to skip.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: Port gunicorn listens on inside the container.

variables.name: WEB_CONCURRENCY
variables.description: Gunicorn worker processes (2-3 per vCPU).

variables.name: GUNICORN_THREADS
variables.description: Threads per worker.

variables.name: GUNICORN_TIMEOUT
variables.description: Request timeout in seconds (large Excel exports).

variables.name: PUBLIC_PAGES
variables.description: Pages opened without sign-in: comma-separated from library, maps, population. Empty keeps everything except the landing page private.

variables.name: PUBLIC_LANDING_STATS
variables.description: Show aggregate counts on the public landing page.

variables.name: SUPPORT_EMAIL
variables.description: Contact shown on the landing page and FAQ; empty hides it.

variables.name: USER_GUIDE_URL
variables.description: Link to a user guide; empty hides it.

variables.name: WEBSITES_PORT
variables.description: Tells App Service which container port to route to. Not used on Container Apps.

variables.name: WEBSITES_ENABLE_APP_SERVICE_STORAGE
variables.description: The container needs no shared /home storage. Not used on Container Apps.
